description: Header file defining the Dumpsys class for Android system service dumping, including method declarations for listing services, starting dump threads, writing dump headers/footers, and managing dump operations.

classes.name: Dumpsys
classes.description: Class providing methods to perform system service dumps, manage dump threads, and handle dump data output.

methods.name: listServices
methods.description: Returns a list of available services filtered by priority and proto support.

methods.name: setServiceArgs
methods.description: Modifies arguments to include dump options such as proto or priority.

methods.name: startDumpThread
methods.description: Starts a thread to connect to a service and retrieve dump output.

methods.name: writeDumpHeader
methods.description: Writes a header for a dump section to a file descriptor.

methods.name: writeDump
methods.description: Redirects service dump output to a file descriptor with timeout and proto options.

methods.name: writeDumpFooter
methods.description: Writes footer information with dump duration to a file descriptor.

methods.name: stopDumpThread
methods.description: Terminates the dump thread, optionally joining it if dump completed.

methods.name: getDumpFd
methods.description: Returns the file descriptor used for dumping service data.
